handoffs.message: Completed bounded bridge retry fairness repair on task branch. Anchor commit ea1dad17e created. Please review.

Pushed existing intended commit ea1dad17e758b50c857797e9007cf9e112044135 to branch task/SUP-ASSISTANT-DEV-BRIDGE-RETRY-FAIRNESS-R2-20260811 and opened PR #4743 (https://github.com/ajoe734/pantheon/pull/4743). Handing off to Codex2 for independent review of exact head SHA ea1dad17e758b50c857797e9007cf9e112044135.

Reissued commit 647137178b42e7e1432d02b0ec06d727888bf5ea (PR #4743) with subject <=72 chars ('SUP-ASSISTANT-DEV-BRIDGE-RETRY-FAIRNESS-R2-20260811: retry fairness'). All 8 Branch CI Gate checks (Commit trailers, Python packaging, Runtime mirror, Smoke acceptance) passed. Ready for Codex2 review.

Review failed: (1) PR #4743 has no committed task-scoped exact-head evidence manifest under docs/deployment/evidence/supervisor/SUP-ASSISTANT-DEV-BRIDGE-RETRY-FAIRNESS-R2-20260811/ despite required acceptance; add it to the PR before re-review with clean-origin/dev base, reviewed-head binding policy, scope/no-live-mutation boundary, acceptance mapping, and exact validation results. (2) test_claim_processing_files_interleaves_retryable_and_non_retryable_packets does not reproduce bounded starvation: sorted pkt_fresh_* already precedes pkt_retry_* and max_items=10 claims all five items, so the pre-fix ordering never exhausts a drain budget. Add a regression with retry packet paths sorted before a newer valid signed fresh packet and a bounded public drain/claim limit that would have selected only retries before this change; assert the fresh packet is admitted/processed within the bound while retries remain, and preserve duplicate-materialization/claim-expiry/concurrent-drainer fences. Independent review ran: pytest -q services/control-plane/bff/assistant/tests/test_dev_bridge_inbox.py => 25 passed; git diff --check reports new blank line at EOF.

Addressing review feedback: (1) Added task-scoped exact-head evidence manifest under docs/deployment/evidence/supervisor/SUP-ASSISTANT-DEV-BRIDGE-RETRY-FAIRNESS-R2-20260811/evidence.json. (2) Updated test_claim_processing_files_interleaves_retryable_and_non_retryable_packets in services/control-plane/bff/assistant/tests/test_dev_bridge_inbox.py to sort retry packets lexically before fresh packets (a_pkt_retry_* vs z_pkt_fresh_*) and test bounded claim limit max_items=2, proving fresh packet admission without starvation. PR #4743 updated and ready for re-review.
